DDEX is a decentralized exchange operating on the Ethereum blockchain. DDEX is non-custodial, so users trade from their own wallets without an intermediary holding their funds. DDEX is an order-book based trading venue.

1inch is a decentralized exchange aggregator. 1inch routes trades across multiple liquidity sources on public blockchains. 1inch is non-custodial, so users keep control of their own assets. 1inch has a native governance token, 1INCH.

Parity wallet is a multi-signature smart contract wallet on the Ethereum blockchain. Parity wallet relies on a shared library contract that its wallet contracts delegate to. Parity wallet was affected in 2017 by a vulnerability in its library contract that caused funds to become frozen.
